{{Quote|There are so many ships in port. With all the refugees headed here, I expected the place to be deserted. If all of these ships are still here&mdash;''where'' did all the refugees go?|Dass Jennir|<ref name="DT 1" />}}
A '''spaceport''' was located within the [[Cadgel Meadows]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]].<ref name="DT 1" /> It was the planet's largest civilian [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|104|Cadgel Meadows}}</ref> One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]&mdash;the [[Politics/Legends|political]] regime of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;the ''[[Uhumele]]'' and its crew landed in the spaceport.<ref name="DT 1" />
